annotations.title: NY award for benefit periods, full CCP engine

description: The full Pro Workspace CCP / Award engine: periods of type TT (total), RE (reduced earnings, with current weekly earnings), TR / TP (a disability percentage of two-thirds of the wage, or a typed weekly rate), NCLT / NME ($0) and HIA (held in abeyance, no weeks); weeks counted with both ends, the shared boundary day once, rounded down to none / tenth / whole (default tenth); each rate within the max and min for the date of accident (RE capped, never raised); an amending period paid at its rate less a prior percentage or prior weekly rate; already-paid periods kept in the award but out of the money moving and fee; employer reimbursements per period with scope "period", "all" or a "specific" date range (or amount unknown); the CCP fee (the weekly CCP amount ÷ 3); prior payments; and the prior-counsel split. Returns every period, the award, the exact fee, the OC-400.1 amount rounded down to $5 and both nets. calculate_ccp_award is the simpler TT/TP/RE version. New York State only. Computes with The Comp Desk calc-core, the same engine as the app and the Pro Workspace; it never estimates. A missing input returns status "missing" and nothing is calculated. Returns the figures, the steps with the rule and engine function behind each, and the not-legal-advice notice.

ccp_weekly_amount.description: Optional: the weekly CCP amount; its fee is the amount ÷ 3.

already_paid.description: This period's award was already paid: kept in the award, out of the money moving and the fee.

amending.description: Amending a prior award for this period: the rate already set, as prior_percent (of two-thirds of the wage) or prior_weekly_rate.

current_weekly_earnings.description: RE: weekly earnings during the period.

employer_reimbursement.description: An employer reimbursement claimed through this period.

scope.description: period (default): this period; all: the whole award; specific: range_start to range_end.

weekly_rate.description: TR/TP instead of a percentage: the weekly rate, in dollars.

prior_counsel_fees.description: Optional: each prior counsel's dollar share of the fee.

prior_payments.description: Optional: dollars already paid on these periods.
